ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Dheliben Mafatlal Seth acquired shares of Prakash Steelage Limited from an immediate relative (brother) via an inter-se transfer by way of gift, increasing her and her PACs' stake from 19.76% to 25.26%. This transaction is exempt under SEBI Takeover Regulations (Regulation 10(1)(a)(i)), therefore not triggering a mandatory open offer, and the filing confirms full regulatory compliance with no apparent red flags, indicating a re-alignment of individual holdings within the promoter group.
